assertions.name: habiro_taylor_coefficients_extracted
assertions.source: Habiro Taylor expansion of [2]_q · (1-h²α) at h=0 computed symbolically via sympy.series; coefficients c_0 through c_8 are exact rationals linear in α.

description: Habiro Taylor expansion of the empirical next-order α_EM form [2]_q · (1 - h²α) at q=1 in h = q-q⁻¹ basis. Tests whether the c_k of the empirical form are clean rationals characteristic of a Habiro element. If yes, the categorical structure underlying α_EM next-order is a Habiro element, and the c_k thrashing is closed by Habiro universality.

habiro_taylor_coefficients_symbolic.recursive_relation: c_k(α) = c_k^{[2]_q} − α · c_{k−2}^{[2]_q}  where c_k^{[2]_q} are exact rational Taylor coefficients of [2]_q = √(4+h²)

data.structural_conclusion: The empirical next-order α_EM form α·[2]_q/(8π)·(1-h²α) is a Habiro element (in q, with α as parameter) whose Taylor coefficients at q=1 in h-basis are EXACT rationals (linear in α). The c_k thrashing is closed by Habiro universality once the underlying categorical Habiro element is named. The framework's open structural question dualizes from 'construct [Z_2] ∈ B_3(ℂ)' (Bloch side) to 'identify the Habiro element' (Habiro side) — equivalent via colored Jones / Kashaev machinery, but Habiro side is more concrete.
